reasoning_summary: All build gates clear and the scoring total (6.7) exceeds the 6.5 build threshold, so the opportunity technically qualifies for build_now. However, the cost-to-gain ratio of 3.588 massively exceeds the kill threshold of 0.6 from cost_gain_model.yaml — even the optimistic scenario (1.794) is nearly 3× the kill line. This signals that at expected conversion rates and ARPU, the economics are deeply unfavorable in the near term. Additionally, responsiveness_signal sits at 2 (no real outreach data), meaning we have zero validation that SFMC developers will actually respond to or pay for this. Building now would commit a week of operator time against a cost-to-gain ratio that the model's own rules flag for kill. The correct move is to defer for one week, run a 20–30 lead cold outreach probe to SFMC developers on LinkedIn and Salesforce community channels, and re-evaluate once we have actual responsiveness data. If responsiveness comes back strong (>8%), the high buyer_clarity and willingness_to_pay scores could justify a build; if it stays flat, the opportunity should be killed.
